entities.summary: The Museum of Contemporary Art (MOCA) is an art museum in Bangkok, Thailand. It is privately owned by business executive Boonchai Bencharongkul and was opened in 2012. The museum, one of the largest contemporary art venues in Asia, features an extensive collection of works by Thai artists, including Thawan Duchanee, Hem Vejakorn, Chalermchai Kositpipat, and Prateep Kochabua.
